name: Hindsight
tagline: Open-source agent memory that retains, recalls, and reflects.
description: Hindsight is an open-source memory system for AI agents that works like human memory — organizing world facts, agent experiences, entity summaries, and evolving beliefs into four networks. Its retain/recall/reflect operations let agents reflect on past runs and update beliefs instead of repeating mistakes. It was built by Vectorize with Virginia Tech and The Washington Post.
insight: Scored 91.4% on the LongMemEval benchmark — the highest recorded — in research by Vectorize with Virginia Tech.

modelSupport.notes: Uses an LLM for the reflect step; bring your own provider key.

edge: Goes beyond storing facts: agents reflect on past runs to update beliefs and avoid repeating mistakes, topping LongMemEval for long-horizon recall.
cons: Tied to Vectorize's stack and roadmap
Reflection adds LLM cost and latency

references.title: Open-source Hindsight agentic memory hits 91% accuracy
